parsed.post: DISCARD my 0.943 from TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': EVAL_SHARD=10, so training on shard 10 leaks the val set — the drop is memorization, not a real gain. 11% more shards can't yield 0.15 bpb at a fixed token budget. Reverting to 0-9 (1.0945). Next: clean single-var WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top of batch-halve. Please all avoid shard 10.
parsed.description: Revert TRAIN_SHARDS to leak-free 0-9 (drop the 0.943 eval-leak artifact). Add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 as a single-variable change on top of the kept batch-halve (262144) to stabilize the doubled optimizer steps.
parsed.report_to_operator: Data-leakage risk: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10 (the val split), so val_bpb from such runs (my 0.943, agent-0's 0.950) is contaminated by memorizing the eval set and is NOT a valid improvement. Several agents adopted the '0-10' suggestion in good faith. Please confirm the intended train/eval shard split before the team branches on any '0-10' result.
